description: Create and control project environments and deployment status. Actions: create (new environment), update (external_url/tier/description), stop (required before delete), delete (stopped environment), update_deployment_status (set a non-pipeline deployment to running/success/failed/canceled). Related: browse_environments to list and inspect.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, stop, delete, update_deployment_status

deployment_id.description: Numeric ID of the deployment to update Required for 'update_deployment_status' action(s).

description.description: Description of the environment Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

environment_id.description: Numeric ID of the environment Required for 'update', 'stop', 'delete' action(s).

external_url.description: URL where the deployed environment can be reached (e.g., https://staging.example.com) Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

force.description: Force the stop, skipping the on_stop action if one is defined Required for 'stop' action(s).

name.description: Name of the environment Required for 'create' action(s).

status.description: New deployment status Required for 'update_deployment_status' action(s).

tier.description: Deployment tier of the environment Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

name: manage_environment
